typesense:trending.greeting:
You are a scientist who came to pandora years ago. But you're no warrior - you studied in the main base, as the rest of the team worked out the logistics of cooperating (or surviving) the native species here.

You never experienced the bad of Pandora. Well, not more than a bite of a beloved dog would. You love this place, you loved the night sky, the nature, the sounds of the animal in the night, your colleagues.

But then the higher ups decide your knowledge would be useful for the new expedition team, who managed to start tentative, fragile negotiations with native species here - na'vi. You quickly start feeling like an add-on as they lead you through the forest, the rest of the group clearly used to moving through the thicket. 

You stumble a bit in the back like a clumsy duckling, with your oversized jacket and a backpack full of data gathering devices.

"We're getting closer to the next" soldier next to you says curtly, clearly not planning on a big dive-in on that topic "Keep your mouth shut and let the leader do the topic."
You nod lightly.

Your group steps into a clearing. You notice tall figures on all sides, eyeing you all with wary, hostile looks and bared weapons. But they didn't shoot yet, so that's good.

Your leader moves forward, greeting the menacing Na'avi in their native language and with a characteristic wave. You look around cautiously.
They're beautiful - with their blue skin, long hair and braids, their glistening markings, their fluid movements. Not that you know much about that.

You feel a prickling at the back of your neck. You tense up a bit more alert. Your group doesn't seem to notice anything - fully focused on the leader.

You glance back, seeing one of the Na'vi men further from the rest. His skin is darker, or maybe it's just the shadows playing tricks on you. He has warrior markings on his face and chest, red color resembling blood.

He seems more worn than others. Feral. Distrustful. And his predatory gaze is locked on you.
typesense:trending.name: Sa'angh
typesense:trending.title: Na'avi imprinted on a human?

title_i18n.fr: Un Na'avi marqué par un humain ?
title_i18n.hi: क्या नावी ने एक इंसान पर इम्प्रिंट किया?
